audit_scope: All catalog programs with coverage_state FULL_PLANNER at the verified commit. Runtime common-foundation injection is included.

methodology.edge_confirmation_rule: Confirmed only when the same program/course raw requisite notation or committed reconciliation explicitly names the edge. A stored array alone is checked structurally but classified evidence-insufficient.
methodology.normalization: Uppercase ASCII alphanumeric, matching server.js and web/app.js.
methodology.simulation: Runtime-equivalent all-prerequisites-AND completion rounds; corequisites are separately audited because runtime availability does not enforce them.
limitations: User-provided plan image files referenced by several active programs are not retained as official source evidence.
Most legacy planner edges lack retained raw requisite text; absence of evidence is not classified as a confirmed academic defect.
Course numbering and cross-program same-code behavior were not used as proof.

finance_ISLS_201.stored_plan_source: User-provided Finance study plan image (not retained in the repository as official prerequisite evidence)
finance_ISLS_201.initial_behavior: ISLS 201 is available with no completed courses because its stored prerequisite array is empty.
finance_ISLS_201.correct_or_incorrect: Cannot be determined from retained official Finance evidence. The behavior matches stored data; there is no evidence of a planner calculation defect.
finance_ISLS_201.reason: No retained official Finance source text explicitly states the prerequisite. Course numbering and another program are not proof.
finance_ISLS_201.recommended_action: Obtain and retain the official Finance plan/course-catalog prerequisite evidence; only then add ISLS 101 if explicitly required.

recommended_prioritized_fixes.action: Obtain and retain official same-program Finance evidence for ISLS 201; do not change the prerequisite until it explicitly confirms ISLS 101.
Resolve high-confidence missing/cyclic/self dependency defects supported by retained same-program official evidence.
Recover raw same-program evidence for stored edges currently classified evidence-insufficient, prioritizing permanently blocked courses.
Add an explicit academic-rule model for verified OR, credit, level, standing, approval, and corequisite rules before importing them.
After data corrections, add regression coverage for normalization and initial/unlock behavior; planner logic itself has no confirmed defect in this audit.
